newsitem.title: USA: GE names three executives to lighting unit.
newsitem.headline: GE names three executives to lighting unit.

text.p: General Electric Co said it named three new officers to its Cleveland-based lighting business.
The company said it named Paul Bossidy, 36, to the new position of vice president and general manager of GE Lighting North America.
It also named Stanley Davis, 49, vice president of commercial and industrial sales, and Robert Herbolich, 53, vice president of consumer sales.

Bossidy had been general manager of the company's appliance unit in Louisville, Ky.; Davis had been general manager of commercial and industrial sales; and Herbolich had been general manager of consumer sales.
